cache.title: Local copies
cache.help: Shared images this Meshloom has fetched are kept here so they are not downloaded again. Clearing them frees disk space; they are fetched again when someone opens them.

uploads.title: My uploads
uploads.intro: Links and files shared from this Meshloom. Deleting one removes it from the share service and from this Meshloom's cache.
uploads.off: Sharing is off, so this Meshloom does not contact the share service and cannot list what it shared. Links and files already shared stay online until they expire.
uploads.empty: Nothing shared from this Meshloom yet.
uploads.error: The list could not be loaded: {{error}}
uploads.blockedHelp: Blocked by the share service, so it cannot be deleted. <contact>Contact the service</contact> if you disagree.

confirm.title: Delete this upload?
confirm.body: It is removed from the share service and from this Meshloom's cache. Anyone who has the link will no longer be able to open it. This cannot be undone.
